name: Grand Hyatt Sao Paulo
positioning: Large Grand Hyatt in Sao Paulo's Berrini business district, with Estaiada Bridge views, a 20th-floor club lounge and the Amanary Spa
best_for: Business travelers working in the Berrini area
Travelers who want city and bridge views with a spa and pool on site

facts.text: The hotel is in Sao Paulo's business district, close to many restaurants, shopping centers and attractions.
The hotel is convenient to corporate offices in the business-heavy Berrini area.
A metro station is a short walk from the hotel.
Guests enter through a sunshine-filled marble lobby.
The 2 Bedroom Residence offers panoramic views of the Estaiada Bridge, expansive windows, a kitchen, a dining area and a living area.
Amanary Spa offers facials, massages and body treatments.
The fitness center has Technogym equipment and offers boxing and yoga classes and personal trainers.
Cittadino is the signature restaurant, serving contemporary Italian cuisine with fresh pasta prepared daily.
The pool is heated with steam exhaust, and recycling and food-waste reduction programs are in place.
The hotel is pet friendly, with a pet park that has toys and a green area.
Congonhas Airport is 6 kilometers from the hotel.

highlights.text: The Diplomatic Suite is a corner suite with floor-to-ceiling windows, a separate dining area and panoramic views of the Ponte Estaiada bridge.
Some rooms offer unobstructed views of Sao Paulo's Estaiada Bridge.
The Grand Club Lounge is on the 20th floor, with high ceilings and city views, and offers club and suite guests complimentary continental breakfast, Wi-Fi, cocktails and appetizers.
Amanary Spa has seven treatment rooms, a sauna, a climatized indoor pool and a cardio and strength studio.
The climatized indoor and outdoor pool has bar service, and a series of waterfalls spill into it to cover traffic noise.

considerations.text: The area is not one where you can walk out the front door and explore interesting shops or cafes; taxis or Ubers are necessary.
The hotel has an attached event center with 17 meeting rooms and event spaces and a grand ballroom, so expect conference and group business.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning and Sao Paulo's cosmopolitan market.
